set.voxels.show.help: Shows the walls as voxels: over the scan, or instead of it (the scan hidden, you fly on the voxels). V switches it; a reload shows the scan again.
set.voxels.style.help: How the voxels are drawn. Floating pieces of the walls stand out in every style; "Floaters in red" colours only them.
set.voxels.opacity.help: How solid the voxels look while the scan shows under them.
set.voxels.opacityOnly.help: How solid the voxels look with the scan hidden.
set.scene.walls.help: Off: the drone flies through everything, no crashes. Kept for each scan; the author may switch the walls of a noisy scan off by default. C switches it.
set.camera.fovDeg.help: How wide the FPV camera sees. Each drone keeps its own value; a change never moves the drone.
set.camera.uptiltDeg.help: How far the FPV camera tilts up; more tilt suits faster flying. Each drone keeps its own value.
set.display.hud.help: The on-screen display: arm state, flight mode, battery, speed and altitude. H hides every text on the flight view for a moment.
set.display.quality.help: Moves the render resolution and detail budget. Physics always runs at 1000 Hz.
set.display.reducedMotion.help: A calmer crash camera without flashes; follows your system setting by default.
set.display.frameStats.help: Screen refresh, frame times and input-to-screen delay over the flight view. F3 switches it.
set.ui.language.help: English, Spanish, Polish or Russian; by default the language of the page.
set.drone.current.help: One of the BetaFPV-class presets; every number on its card says where it comes from. Each drone keeps its own settings.
set.physics.gravity.help: Earth 9.81, Moon 1.62, Mars 3.72, zero-g, or any value in between.
set.physics.gravityMode.help: Same motors (honest), the thrust-to-weight you have on Earth, or auto throttle that hovers at stick centre.
set.physics.twr.help: Maximum thrust divided by weight; the preset takes it from the manufacturer or an estimate.
set.physics.tauMs.help: How fast the motors reach a new speed; lower feels snappier.
set.physics.dragScale.help: Scales the air drag of the frame: more drag slows the drone down sooner.
set.physics.ductDrag.help: Rotor and duct drag that damps a cinewhoop's speed and wobble.
set.physics.propInertia.help: Scales the spin inertia of the props: more inertia softens throttle and turns.
set.physics.idlePct.help: Motor speed at zero throttle, like Betaflight's DShot idle value.
set.tune.pid.help: P, I, D and feed-forward for roll, pitch and yaw, for each drone, as in Betaflight.
set.tune.rates.help: Betaflight, Actual, KISS or Raceflight rate curves, imported from your Betaflight CLI diff, for each drone.
set.tune.throttle.help: Throttle mid and expo, as in Betaflight, for each drone.
